However, they have new horns known as [[Blue Lizalfos Horn]]s, which they can attack [[Link]] with. ==Other Appearances== ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{CoH}}, Blue Lizalfos are not stronger than [[Green Lizalfos]], but they do wield [[Spear]]s, giving them a much farther reach when they attack. While their movement is bound to the beat of the music, they typically stand still until one of the heroes crosses their path. Once they have a hero within their sights, they will proceed to charge at them within a straight line, moving on every beat until they collide into something or the hero stops their attack with their [[Weapon]], stunning them for three beats. While stunned, they are rendered completely defenseless until they regain consciousness on the fourth beat, returning to their original stance to look for targets. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Enemies |category= Enemies in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * The Enemy's behavior * The Enemy's weaknesses }} {{Stub|AoI}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Moblin and Lizalfos Concept Artwork.jpg|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept art of Blue Lizalfos and other Monsters File:TotK Blue Lizalfos Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Gloom-Wreathed Blue Lizalfos File:CoH Blue Lizalfos Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{CoH|-}}}}Artwork of a Blue Lizalfos File:CoH Blue Lizalfos Sprite.png|{{Game Label|{{CoH|-}}}}A Blue Lizalfos File:AoC Blue Lizalfos Portrait Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Portrait of a Blue Lizalfos ==See Also== {{See Also| * Enemy * Lizalfos * Monster }} {{Ref| {{Cite|'''Blue Lizalfos'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} {{Cite|These quick-witted, lizard-like monsters can be found all over Hyrule.
